limitations: One owned request-only process; background, production workers and fleet workloads are not measured.
Sampling selfSize is live sampled allocation, not total heap or a retained-state owner.
Completed-result diagnostic bytes are PostgreSQL wire bytes, not HTTP, payload storage or retained heap.
Diagnostic/snapshot modes label profiler/GC interventions; ordinary mode performs neither profiler mutation nor forced GC.
Snapshot census reports post-GC V8 node self sizes, not exclusive retained ownership or production savings.
Idle windows are bounded private HTTP baseline windows, not ambient production idle or leak evidence.

census.definition: V8 snapshot node self_size, after snapshot GC; not retained/exclusive bytes or total native memory.

heapRetainers.definition: Node retained_size is dominator-owned V8 self_size; class retained sizes overlap. Not total native memory or production savings.
heapRetainers.privacy: String payloads, source text, filesystem names and edge/property names are omitted.
heapRetainers.retainerDefinition: Depth-one unique incoming parents; excludes weak edges, non-root shortcuts, root and the queried node. First essential edge type per parent; no edge names.
